requirements.title: Allocated Budget Field
requirements.definition: Populate each agreement's allocated-budget field with the supplied full site or program allocation, distinct from the smaller amount used by the specific subcontract.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the meaning and value of the allocated-budget field, including the distinction between full program allocation and subcontract amount; personnel calculations and allocation of remaining costs are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Subcontractor Signature Placement
requirements.definition: Ensure the required signature appears in the subcontractor section rather than the contractor section of each affected agreement.
requirements.boundary_note: Signature presence and placement can fail or be corrected independently of budget, schedule, and support-sheet content.

requirements.title: Agreement Date Consistency
requirements.definition: Apply each site's supplied start and end dates consistently to every applicable date field in its agreement, including term and schedule sections.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers agreement-wide synchronization of start and end dates; the independently specified number of weeks served remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Session-Based Personnel Calculation
requirements.definition: Calculate personnel compensation on the salary and wages support sheet from the actual total number of sessions and the per-session charge rather than assuming a fixed number of sessions every week.
requirements.boundary_note: The session count and per-session rate are parameters of one personnel-cost calculation; assignment of any remaining budget to non-personnel lines is independently adjustable.

requirements.title: Approved Non-Personnel Budget Allocation
requirements.definition: Place budget amounts not supported by personnel calculations only in approved non-personnel lines, such as travel and consumable supplies.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers categorization of the gap remaining after personnel costs are calculated, not the session-based calculation itself or the value entered in the allocated-budget field.

requirements.title: Annex B Weeks Served
requirements.definition: Record seven weeks served, rather than 11.5 weeks, in the Annex B Page 5 support information for the affected NCA/NH and 286R agreements.
requirements.boundary_note: Weeks served is a distinct calculation/input field that can change independently of calendar start and end dates.

requirements.title: Site Designation
requirements.definition: Use the client-confirmed site identities and labels in the agreements, treating NCA and NH as the same school and retaining 286R as the final document designation rather than replacing it with 201.
requirements.boundary_note: The school aliases and selected document label are parameters of one site-identification mechanism; contract-ID handling is a separate field decision.

requirements.title: Missing Contract ID Handling
requirements.definition: Do not invent contract identifiers for the NCA/NH and 286R agreements when the contracts contact has not supplied them.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers treatment of absent contract-ID fields only; it does not determine the displayed site name or other agreement values.
